cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: This beloved children's program offers a refreshing alternative to overstimulating modern shows designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents can feel good letting their toddlers watch content that's actually educational and calming.

cards.title: Sleepover Safety: The Secret Codeword Strategy
cards.body: Establish a discreet codeword so your child can signal distress at sleepovers without embarrassment. This simple trick gives kids an exit strategy when they're genuinely unhappy without losing face in front of peers.

cards.title: Working Parents Face Impossible Scheduling Logistics
cards.body: School days ending at 3pm while work runs until 5pm+ creates a structural crisis for working families. The current system forces parents into constant admin and stress without adequate school holiday coverage.

cards.title: Anxious Children and Bedtime Battles: Expert Tips
cards.body: Children with anxiety often resist sleeping alone, but there are evidence-based strategies professionals use. Learning these techniques helps parents handle tantrums without giving in to avoidance patterns.

cards.title: Three Ways Parents Undermine Their Child's Confidence
cards.body: Excessive help can teach kids they're incapable of handling life independently. Parents should recognize when support becomes enabling and step back to build genuine confidence.
